analyst.summary: PTC India is a financially healthy, well-capitalised power-trading company (very low debt, healthy dividend) earning decent double-digit returns, but the underlying power-trading market has matured -- India's discoms and generators increasingly transact directly or via exchanges rather than through intermediaries -- and revenue has been essentially flat for several years. We see this as a Sell for portfolio purposes: the low valuation reflects a genuine structural growth ceiling rather than a market mispricing.
